example_sentences_in_bangla: তিনি সরকারের গদিতে বসার জন্য প্রস্তুত হচ্ছেন।
এই গদি অর্জন করা সহজ নয়।
example_sentences_in_english: He is preparing to ascend to the seat of power in the government.
Achieving this throne is not easy.
history: The term 'গদি' originates from Persian and Urdu, referring to the throne or seat used by rulers in historical Indian subcontinent courts, symbolizing royal or ministerial authority.
note: Often used in contexts of political ascension or high office.
